script_text: Stop, Aquarius: your Air sign is being rewired by a rare Saturn-Uranus trine. Saturn in your 3rd House is trining Uranus, your ruling planet, in the 5th House, while Jupiter in the 6th House sextiles Uranus too. This is not background static; it snaps your words, flirtation, and ideas into sharper focus. Single Aquarius attracts someone clever, slightly unconventional, possibly through a class, coworker, clinic, or dog walk; taken Aquarius, avoid turning a tiny schedule clash into a power test. For career and money, your 10th House gets a practical lift from the 6th-to-5th House flow: pitch the creative fix, revise the invoice, and ask for payment before the weekend. Pluto in your 1st House makes you magnetic, so avoid oversharing the plan before it's funded, because contracts can tangle fast. Subscribe so you don't miss what's coming this week.
